quadratic_form_normalization.divisor_counting: even completed-Xi divisor with positive ordinates counted once

prime_translation_terms.translation_direction: T_a f(x)=f(x+a), a=log(n), with zero extension

prefactors: 1/2 on a_plus a_minus^* + a_minus a_plus^*; quadratic value Re(a_plus conjugate(a_minus))

zero_extension_convention: Functions on [-L,L] are extended by zero to R before translation and Fourier transform.

dirichlet_comparison_map.matrix_element_rule: integrate the unitary Fourier multiplier plus the half-sum endpoint matrix
dirichlet_comparison_map.domain_statement: The basis lies in H_log,L and is the graph-norm closure of smooth compact interval tests via H^s approximation for 0<s<1/2.
